provenance.authoringMethod: independent direct transcription of frozen counter and identifier maxima plus explicit exact and attempted-plus-one boundary pairing

limitPolicy.trueAttemptedPlusOne: A plus-one case represents an actual attempt to accept the next work unit or allocate the next tracked record after the counter is already at its inclusive maximum.
limitPolicy.refusal: Every true attempted maximum-plus-one returns limit.voicing_work_exceeded with path [], the exact counter, received maximum plus one, maximum, partialResult false, termination work-limit-exceeded, and no partial value.
limitPolicy.exactLimit: Reaching the exact maximum is allowed by that limit. The exact-limit case fixes the evidence value but does not by itself fix the operation's later musical outcome.
limitPolicy.retentionException: The first 24 eligible candidates after stable ordering are retained. A 25th eligible ordered raw candidate is truncated without attempting a 25th retained allocation, so it does not trigger the retained counter plus-one refusal.
limitPolicy.rawCandidateRule: Exactly 96 raw candidates may be accepted. A true attempt to accept raw candidate 97 is a limit refusal and returns no partial candidate value.
limitPolicy.constraintObservationQualification: Exact semantic duplicates collapse before capacity. Only a prospective seventeenth distinct full-payload observation attempts constraintObservationsProduced value 17.
limitPolicy.constraintObservationOverflow: Observation overflow is provisional while no legal candidate has been found: diagnostic collection stops but musical search continues. The first legal candidate clears and disables the provisional overflow. Only a completed zero-candidate search returns the typed all-or-nothing work-limit refusal.

identifierPolicy.candidateEvidenceLaw: An invalid sourceId may never be emitted in candidate evidence.

checksums.recordProjectionFormat: one compact JSON array per record in stored order, followed by LF
checksums.fixturePayloadProjection: one compact JSON object with recursively sorted keys and checksums removed, followed by LF

expected.explanation: The 25th eligible ordered raw candidate is not an attempted 25th retained allocation and therefore is not itself a limit refusal.
